summary: Norwood Financial Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per share, payable August 3, 2026 to holders of record July 15, 2026. The dividend is unchanged from the prior quarter. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. The company is a Pennsylvania-based bank holding company with $2.9 billion in assets. There is no risk-arb, structural mechanic, or strategic review to analyze.
